text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is victorious. Watching from 
home, her family offers words of gratitude 
and celebration, saying, "All that matters 
to us is that you run safe and sound."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the defeated Oguri Cap wished 
to take on a triple crown of G1s: the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), followed by the Japan 
Cup and the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the Arima Kinen. Whether 
to proceed to the Japan Cup was left up to 
Tamamo Cross and her Trainer.
